title: Data from: "Microcredit to women and its contribution to production and household food security"
descriptions: This data was collected as part of the PhD project for Faith Muyonga Namayengo. Respondents were BRAC microfinance clients in three districts of Uganda. The baseline data collection was in 2013 while the follow up study was in the year 2014. Data collection was funded by the NUFFIC Netherlands Fellowship Program and the SEPON Foundation
